key_insight: A pre-trained transformer accelerates distillation of opaque neural A-life controllers into compact symbolic policies for interpretation and knowledge sharing.
engineering_relevance: Symbolic policies enable agents with different neural architectures to exchange behavioral knowledge without transferring incompatible neural weights.
method: Pre-train a transformer on random percept–action data.
Select the transformer architecture through neural architecture search.
Distill neural controllers into symbolic policies for self-reflection, teaching, and learning.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports substantially faster distillation and empirical comparisons of distillation methods and symbolic policy spaces, including their effects on A-life population dynamics.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical speedup or policy-fidelity results, leaving the practical trade-off between efficiency and behavioral accuracy unclear.
paper_title: Using Transformers for Teaching and Learning via Symbolic Distillation of Neural A-life Agents
